KiviConnection.title: Kivi integration
KiviConnection.subtitle: Connect your store to Kivi to keep your catalog in sync, with nothing technical to set up.
KiviConnection.notConnectedHelp: All you need is a pairing code generated in Kivi.

steps.one: In Kivi: Integrations → Connect application → Generate code.
steps.two: Copy the code (it starts with kvp_).
steps.three: Paste it here and press Connect. It works once and expires soon.

KiviConnection.codeHelp: Starts with kvp_. Do not paste any connection token here.
KiviConnection.ownerOnly: Only the store owner can manage this connection.

pending.title: Connecting
pending.help: Your store is connected. We are sending your catalog to Kivi; this can take a few minutes.

active.title: Connected
active.help: Your catalog is kept in sync automatically.

needs_reconcile.title: Needs attention
needs_reconcile.help: Your catalog may be out of date in Kivi. Press Sync now to bring it up to date.

KiviConnection.legacyNote: This connection uses a token configured manually on the server. Disconnect it and connect again with a code to manage it from here.
KiviConnection.syncNowHelp: The sync runs in the background on the next cycle.
KiviConnection.disconnectConfirm: We will stop syncing your catalog and revoke access in Kivi. You can connect again with a new code.
KiviConnection.paired: Store connected. The initial catalog load will start shortly.
KiviConnection.unlinked: Your store was disconnected from Kivi.
KiviConnection.syncRequested: Sync requested. It will run on the next cycle.
KiviConnection.unauthorized: Sign in with an active store to manage the integration.
KiviConnection.forbidden: Only the store owner can manage the Kivi connection.
KiviConnection.notLinked: The store has no Kivi connection.
KiviConnection.unexpected: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

errors.invalidOrExpired: The code is not valid or has expired. Generate a new one in Kivi and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.unavailable: We could not reach Kivi. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.notConfigured: The Kivi integration is not available on this platform yet. Contact support.

validation.codeFormat: The code must start with kvp_. Copy it in full from Kivi.
